ios.desc:
PAM isn't another app. She's your family's personal assistant.

She gathers everything from wherever family life happens — emails, school newsletters, sports rosters, screenshots, voice notes, calendars, photos, and the things taking up room in your head — and turns it into one clear, shared plan that thinks three steps ahead.

Not another app to learn. Just relief you can actually feel.

EVERY AREA OF FAMILY LIFE, HANDLED

PAM reads, schedules and thinks ahead across every corner of family life:

- School communications — newsletters, emails, permission slips, excursions, holiday dates
- Mental load — everything living rent-free in your head, out and organised
- Home management — bills, maintenance, car service, subscriptions
- Sports & activities — game days, training schedules, gear reminders
- Travel — itineraries, bookings, packing lists sorted in advance
- Medical — appointments, prescriptions, follow-ups
- Birthdays & events — the ones you swear you won't forget, remembered, plus party planning
- Meal planning & groceries — lists built around your actual week
- School holidays — planned, and details noted for less of a headache
- Kids' chores — assigned, tracked, done

HOW PAM WORKS

SEND PAM ANYTHING
Forward an email. Screenshot a WhatsApp message. Drop a photo of that permission slip. Voice note your grocery run. PAM reads it, extracts what matters, and turns it into events, tasks and reminders — automatically. No copying across apps.

THINKS THREE STEPS AHEAD
PAM doesn't just capture what you throw at her — she anticipates what comes next. She'll remind you to pack the sports gear the night before the game. RSVP and buy the birthday present a week before the party. 

BRAIN DUMP
Unload everything in your head — by voice or by text. PAM transforms it into events, tasks, notes and lists. A second brain that remembers everything so yours doesn't have to. You’ll feel lighter instantly.

ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH
Syncs with Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple Calendar. Every schedule — school, sport, work, home — colour-coded, shared and in one place. PAM also lives inside your existing calendars, not instead of them.

A TASK LIST THAT WORKS WITH YOUR DAY
Know what needs doing, what's urgent, and what can shift. Prioritise and reshuffle based on how your day is actually unfolding. Assign tasks to your partner, kids or caregivers — without another "Can you please help me with this?" conversation.

LIVE SHARED NOTES & LISTS
Collaborative notes and lists shared

quotes.text:
Sounds interesting. There's one person in my family who is particularly good at this. We could all learn a lot from them if we had regular "family admin" parties.

I found the app and it's website. Links for reference:

https://www.pamfamilymanager.com/

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pam-smart-family-planner/id6736663458

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=co.mypam.app&hl=en_US&pli=1
quotes.story_title: Do you need an admin party to get your life back in order?
